snippet.title: Planetary Life out now on Steam Early Access
snippet.description:
Planetary Life is a planet, life and evolution simulation game.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471970/Planetary_Life?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=earlyaccessrelease

📺 Planetary Life Devlog playlist:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDS6fZcGwxlsAvh_X2qD5bQ53uMBSDdE0&si=HVFLCRJPw2DuPfur

🌍 Discord server:
https://discord.gg/rN4KFgkVu8

🔥 Follow on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/pitxardo
https://twitter.com/sotenbox

A game about full planet and climate, evolution and survival simulation.
From cells to creatures and monsters to civilizations.
Evolve animals and plants and simulate artificial ecosystems.
Everything is procedurally generated.

#evolution #simulation #devlog #ecosystem #game #procedural #planet #science
